caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object, possibly a fabric panel or covering, with a predominantly dark green or black background. At the center, there is a symmetrical floral motif consisting of three large stylized flowers—one central red flower with yellow highlights and two red and yellow side flowers—surrounded by green leafy branches forming a wreath-like oval shape. The floral design is accented with small yellow and red circular elements. At the base of the central motif is a red ribbon-like decoration with bows. The textile is bordered by a repeating geometric Greek key pattern in yellow and green, outlined in red, with small circular accents along the inner border. The outer edge of the fabric is trimmed with red fringe. The fabric appears to be ornamented with symmetrical patterns and traditional forms. The overall composition centers the floral and wreath motif, framed by the geometric border and accented with the fringe along the lower edge.
title: Circus Pony Robe
